rules.name: account-and-org-create
rules.expression: http.host eq "api.lokiplay.cc" and http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path eq "/v1/organizations"

rules.name: project-create
rules.expression: http.host eq "api.lokiplay.cc" and http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path eq "/v1/projects"

rules.name: session-minting
rules.expression: http.host eq "api.lokiplay.cc" and http.request.method eq "POST" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/v1/player-sessions" or http.request.uri.path eq "/v1/nakama-session")

rules.name: deployments
rules.expression: http.host eq "api.lokiplay.cc" and http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path contains "/v1/deployments"
